notes: Group B re-check. Eligible with a stated price: TopEstrellas (Liderazgo 129 €/mes excl. tax; the stored 'Pedidos 24' price is gone) and pidopago (365 €/año and 485 €/año — yearly only, no monthly figure on the site; VAT not stated). Eligible without a price: Cheerfy Shop (no Shop price anywhere; the pricing page is for loyalty plans, so the stored 'Starter 99' is not a Shop price) and FesteaPay (event/festival mobile ordering naming foodtrucks; only a 1.5%–3% commission line in the FAQ, owner unclear). Only food-truck-type tool found: FesteaPay, and it has no price, so fewer than 2 food-truck tools qualify with a price. Three searches for Spanish food-truck order-ahead tools found only foreign apps (Food Truck Pub, Yumm Trux, Flash Order via Square's marketplace), directories (Capterra) and marketplaces; none added. Ordeno's own site is ordeno.app (English body, 'restaurants, stadiums, and events', no order-ahead wording, no plans) — not_relevant. FesteaPay's own site is festeapay.com. Check: own site not found. EatSelf is a French-only tool (move to FR). The TopEstrellas homepage reader once refused to give verbatim text; all quotes used came from later reads that returned exact wording.
